query: UPDATE payday_allocations SET title=$3,section=$4,kind=$5,category_id=$6,subcategory_id=$7,category_name=$8,subcategory_name=$9,amount=$10,notes=$11,completed_at=CASE WHEN $12::timestamptz IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(completed_at,$12) END,template_id=$13,expense_group_id=$14,expense_group_name=$15,position=$16 WHERE household_id=$1 AND id=$2
